name: Externalauth Gitlab OAuth2 Connector
description: OAuth 2.0 login connector that authenticates Drupal users against a GitLab instance through the External Authentication framework.
project_description: Externalauth Gitlab OAuth2 Connector lets site users authenticate against a running GitLab instance (self-hosted or gitlab.com) via OAuth 2.0. It adds a "Log in via Gitlab" local task under /user that redirects the visitor to GitLab for authorization and handles the OAuth callback on return. The GitLab identity is resolved through the External Authentication (externalauth) framework: an existing externalauth link logs the user in directly, otherwise the module maps the GitLab account to an existing Drupal user by email address. It does not register new users. Configuration (GitLab client ID, client secret and instance domain) is entered on a settings form under Configuration → People. The OAuth flow is built on the omines/oauth2-gitlab and league/oauth2-client PHP libraries.
